title: forecast_preview.dem header annotations describe a stale capture schedule, not the actual goldens
evidence: #   1300ms — preview 1 -> wide:  "2 routes reroute to node 2" + / #            card; weather shows NOW. / run 33500ms / capture at 30000ms / capture at 31000ms / "start_tick": 1200 (data/demand.json)
detail: The card-state annotations misdocument the golden: no capture exists at 1300ms (captures are 30000-33000ms), and the surge starts at tick 1200 (60000ms), so the weather card never shows NOW during the 33500ms run.
recommended_fix: Correct the annotation block to the actual capture times (30000/31000/32000/33000ms) and the countdown-only weather state.

title: Unknown at-verb error message omits the new preview verb from its hint list
evidence: return {}, fmt.tprintf("unknown at-verb %q (want draw|spawn|demolish|place|emphasis|lane): %s", fields[2], line)
detail: The diff added the `preview` case to the same switch but left the error hint listing only draw|spawn|demolish|place|emphasis|lane — a typo'd verb misdirects the author about the valid set.
recommended_fix: Append "|preview" to the want-list in the error string.
